payload.summary: Implement the guide freshness mechanism per ticket a1cy1xmn's decision: a repo script that regenerates the two generator-owned marked regions in docs/guide.md (nahel-guide:begin/end verbs — projected from the src/cli.ts COMMANDS registry; nahel-guide:begin/end workflows — projected from nahel/workflows/*.md frontmatter name/description/args) byte-identically, plus a bun test that runs it in check mode and fails on any diff (exact compare, no markdown parsing; also fails on uncommitted regeneration). Prose outside the markers must never be touched. The initial tables were hand-projected on 2026-08-19 and match v0.4.3 — the first generator run should be a no-op diff, which doubles as its acceptance test.
